# Unit Converter MCP

> 60+ physical units, live currency conversion, IANA timezone conversion, date diffs

This MCP server exposes 6 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `convert_unit`: Convert between physical units across 10 categories (length, mass, volume, area, time, temperature, energy, speed, data, pressure).
- `list_units`: List all supported units grouped by category.
- `convert_currency`: Convert between currencies with live FX. Optional ISO date for historical rates.
- `convert_timezone`: Re-anchor an ISO datetime from one IANA timezone to another.
- `date_diff`: Difference between two ISO dates in ms / seconds / minutes / hours / days / weeks.
- `list_timezones`: Supported IANA timezones + UTC offsets.

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $5/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $15/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $39/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.

## Account management
- View account: GET https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account (Bearer)
- Rotate key: POST https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/rotate (Bearer)
- GDPR data export: GET https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/export (Bearer)
- Team management (Team+): https://unit-converter-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/team
